current.text: He is out with a torn Achilles until at least about March, so he will miss most of the season.
He is expected to return around March on a minutes limit.
Do not draft him. He will not matter in any fantasy league this season.
With a March 28 end, Minnesota plays 4, 2 and 4 games in the fantasy playoff weeks, so the semifinal week has only two games. This falls in the only part of the season he may play.

durable.text: He tore his Achilles in the 2026 NBA playoffs.
His fantasy value depends on getting minutes and decent usage. He shoots well fairly consistently.

note: Do not spend a pick or a dollar on him in our 144-player auction. Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 252, ESPN rank 348), and he went for 1 USD in our league last season. Watch the news around March: if he comes back, it will be on a minutes limit and right before a two-game semifinal week, so at most he is a late waiver pickup for 3PM and steals in deep weeks.
